Name: Gigi's Custom Shirts

Description:
I apologize in advance! Some of these shirts are edited versions of other artist's already existing shirt/clothing mods. it has been years since I've first gotten those mods and edited these shirts so I have no idea who they are anymore. (lost the original files too)
Although if you do recognize the artist or if you are the artist and you recognize your shirt mod in here I will happily change it!
I'm so sorry, again!

Adds new shirts to the game.
These are best used with the mod(s) Kisekae or Getdressed (for the skirts).
